name: Celeste Zhao
source:
DOB: 02/02/2100
Subjects Studied: Art, English Lit, English Lang

Celeste Zhao can often be found hanging out with Zhenya and Connor but is also a childhood friend of Yva's. They lost touch since going to different high schools but, by chance, ended up at the same 6th form college. She is loud and not afraid to speak her mind and because of this can sometimes get on people's nerves, especially Connor's. Due to her interest in art and fashion, she often adds different accessories to her uniform, some of which she makes herself.
